title: Luggage Compartment Lid Release Switch
introduction:
This luggage-compartment release switch lives in the rear bumper cover, just above the license-plate recess. A trunk-release name, a bumper-cover address—I use the drawing to find the actual part before reaching for the trim tool.

The job separates into freeing the switch housing and disconnecting its wiring. The inset shows the retaining features and connector separately; installation puts them back in the opposite order.

items.name: Trim-removal tool
items.detail: Use the trim-removal tool depicted in the illustration to release the switch from the bumper cover.

items.name: Review the service precautions
items.detail: Before beginning, review [Health and Safety Precautions](#/document/G1693189).

items.name: Eye, ear and hand protection
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection when servicing the vehicle. Wear protective gloves when handling parts with pointed or sharp edges. Failure to use the required protection may result in serious personal injury.

items.name: Prevent an accidental start
items.detail: Switch the ignition OFF and remove the key from the vehicle to prevent another person from accidentally starting the engine during service. An accidental start may result in serious personal injury.

items.name: Disable remote start when equipped
items.detail: Before working around the vehicle at the rear bumper, disable remote start using the Central Display at Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup. Otherwise, the vehicle could be remotely started at any time, potentially causing personal injury or death.

edits.text: Remove the luggage compartment lid release switch using the release-and-disconnect sequence below.
edits.why: The housing must come free of the bumper cover before the switch can be separated from its electrical connection.

edits.text: Use the illustrated trim-removal tool to release the luggage compartment lid release switch from the bumper cover at the retaining features highlighted in the inset.
edits.why: I use the highlighted retainers to distinguish the mechanical attachment from the connector latch. Freeing the housing provides access to the plug behind it.

edits.text: Release and disconnect the electrical connector shown in the inset, then remove the luggage compartment lid release switch.
edits.why: The switch is ready to come away once both its bumper-cover attachment and electrical connection are released. The wiring is a connection, not an extraction handle.

edits.text: Reverse the removal sequence: reconnect the electrical connector, then refit the luggage compartment lid release switch into the bumper cover with its retaining features engaged.
edits.why: The connector restores the electrical connection; the retainers secure the housing in the bumper-cover opening. The supplied sequence ends with refitting and includes no operational test.

changes.before: Remove the key from the vehicle to prevent another person from accidentally starting the engine during service. An accidental start may result in serious personal injury.
changes.after: Switch the ignition OFF and remove the key from the vehicle to prevent another person from accidentally starting the engine during service. An accidental start may result in serious personal injury.

startupClarification.reason: Explicit ignition OFF and conditional remote start in existing preparation; technical procedure unchanged.
